analyses.estimateComment: Hodges-Lehmann location-shift estimate of the overall treatment difference with 95% CI was reported.
analyses.pValueComment: P-value was obtained from the aligned rank stratified Wilcoxon test with background therapy as strata.
analyses.statisticalComment: Participants who died before Week 52, had missing % predicted FVC change from baseline values at visit(s) on or after death date imputed.

primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The FVC measurement indicates the amount of air a person can forcefully and quickly exhale after taking a deep breath.

groups.description: Treprostinil for inhalation solution (0.6 mg/mL) delivered via an ultrasonic nebulizer which emits a dose of approximately 6 mcg per breath. Inhaled QID and titrated up to a target of 12 breaths QID or until the subject reaches their maximum clinically tolerated dose.
groups.title: Inhaled Treprostinil

groups.description: Matching placebo inhaled using an ultrasonic nebulizer QID
groups.title: Placebo

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Intent-to-Treat (ITT) Population (all participants randomized into the study who received at least 1 dose of the study drug)
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Change in Absolute FVC From Baseline to Week 52
